text: As I move from the brightly lit, almost sterile corridor into this vibrant and thought-provoking exhibit, I experience a quiet curiosity. The bold letters R+D invite me to ponder the relationship between research, innovation, and the future. I feel a sense of anticipation, eager to engage with the ideas displayed around me, but also strangely aware of my own presence, as if I am both observer and participant in an ongoing experiment of human progress.
